question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Assiduous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Idle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assiduous** means working very hard and taking great care that everything is done as well as it can be.

** • Example- ***They were** assiduous **in their search for all the latest facts and figures.*

 
• Marked option **Idle** means not wanting to work hard; lazy.

** • Example-* ****An** idle **man's brain is the devil's workshop.*

 
• It is clear that **Assiduous** and** Idle** are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anxious** means worried and afraid.
 
• **Destitute** means without any money, food, or a home.
 
• **Unique** means not like anything else; being the only one of its type.
